build_semseg_evaluator: build a SemSegEvaluator instance for a named dataset with distributed evaluation and output directory
reset_confusion_matrix: reset the SemSegEvaluator confusion matrix and predictions list before a new evaluation run
process_predictions: process model inputs and semantic segmentation outputs to accumulate confusion matrix and predictions
evaluate_semseg_metrics: evaluate semantic segmentation metrics including mIoU, fwIoU, mACC, and pACC across all classes
encode_json_sem_seg: encode semantic segmentation predictions into COCO stuff format with RLE-encoded mask segments
